meta.title: Awesome CTR Scaling
meta.description: Scaling laws and scalable ranking models for industrial recommendation.
meta.scope: We cover papers that (1) study scaling laws for recommendation models, (2) propose scalable Transformer-based architectures for CTR/ranking, (3) address efficiency challenges in scaling up industrial ranking systems, or (4) explore novel paradigms (e.g., sparse scaling, generative pre-training, foundation models) for scalable recommendation.

categories.title: Scaling Law & Theory

papers.title: Understanding Scaling Laws for Recommendation Models
papers.contribution: First systematic study of scaling laws for DLRM-style CTR models; shows power-law + constant behavior across model size, data size, and compute

papers.title: Wukong: Towards a Scaling Law for Large-Scale Recommendation
papers.contribution: Proposes factorized stacked interaction layers enabling effective parameter scaling; demonstrates scaling law for recommendation

papers.title: SUAN: Exploring Scaling Laws of CTR Model for Online Performance Improvement
papers.contribution: Systematically explores how CTR model scaling translates to online performance; practical methodology for scaling decisions

papers.title: Climber: Toward Efficient Scaling Laws for Large Recommendation Models
papers.contribution: Multi-scale sequence extraction + dynamic temperature modulation; first publicly documented continuous online scaling

papers.title: FAT: From Scaling to Structured Expressivity: Rethinking Transformers for CTR Prediction
papers.contribution: Field-Aware Transformer with decomposed content alignment; first formal scaling law for CTR based on Rademacher complexity

papers.title: Kunlun: Establishing Scaling Laws for Massive-Scale Recommendation Systems Through Unified Architecture Design
papers.contribution: Unified architecture design for predictable scaling laws; governs relationship between performance and computational investment

papers.title: SparseCTR: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-Term Behaviors for CTR Prediction
papers.contribution: Three-branch sparse attention for long behaviors; demonstrates scaling law across 3 orders of magnitude in FLOPs

papers.title: LLaTTE: Scaling Laws for Multi-Stage Sequence Modeling in Large-Scale Ads Recommendation
papers.contribution: Power-law scaling for ads rec; two-stage async architecture; largest user model at Meta

papers.title: ULTRA-HSTU: Bending the Scaling Law Curve in Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
papers.contribution: Sparse Attention + FlashAttention-V3; bends the scaling curve beyond HSTU

papers.title: On the Practice of Scaling Search Conversion Rate Prediction
papers.contribution: Search CVR scaling: empirical study across backbone compute / embedding size / training data; warmstart training + decoupled graph execution + dynamic batching

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Behavioral Foundation Models over User Event Sequences
papers.contribution: Systematic scaling law study for behavioral foundation models across ~600 runs and 10^15-10^19 FLOPs; reveals compute-optimal embedder size and metric-dependent scaling dynamics

papers.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
papers.contribution: Recipe for training transformer recommenders up to 1B parameters; establishes scaling recipe for recommendation transformers

papers.title: Principled Synthetic Data Enables the First Scaling Laws for LLMs in Recommendation

papers.title: DeRes: Decoupling Residual Stability and Adaptivity for Scalable CTR Prediction
papers.contribution: Dual-path residual with Pointwise AttnRes; fits steeper compute–AUC scaling law (γ=0.118 vs 0.071); 2× compute saving at equivalent AUC

papers.title: SPRINT: The Pitfall of Scaling Up: Uncovering and Mitigating Popularity Bias Amplification in Scaling Transformer-based Recommenders
papers.contribution: Identifies spectral collapse causing popularity bias amplification; SPRINT regularization enables more favorable scaling from 0.05M to 0.34B params

papers.title: UniRank: Benchmarking Ranking Models for Unified Sequential Modeling and Feature Interaction

papers.title: Beyond Interaction Capacity: Estimator Scaling with Recursive Models for CTR Prediction

papers.contribution: Introduces estimator scaling beyond saturated interaction capacity; RECAP combines ensemble distillation, trajectory EMA and mean-logit aggregation of low-rank-adapted routes in weight-shared recursive cross networks, approaching a five-model ensemble with about one-fifth of its deployed parameters

papers.title: DHEN: A Deep and Hierarchical Ensemble Network for Large-Scale Click-Through Rate Prediction
papers.contribution: Hierarchical ensemble of heterogeneous interaction modules; co-designed training system for efficiency

papers.title: Hiformer: Heterogeneous Feature Interactions Learning with Transformers for Recommender Systems
papers.contribution: Learns heterogeneous feature interactions via Transformers; addresses sparse high-dimensional input challenges

papers.title: HSTU: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
papers.contribution: Hierarchical Sequential Transduction Unit; scales to trillion parameters; generative recommendation paradigm

papers.title: InterFormer: Effective Heterogeneous Interaction Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction
papers.contribution: Heterogeneous feature interaction with user profile, context, and behavior signals for CTR

papers.title: RankMixer: Scaling Up Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
papers.contribution: Efficient TokenMixer-based architecture for scaling ranking models; addresses training and serving cost

papers.title: HHFT: Hierarchical Heterogeneous Feature Transformer for Recommendation Systems

papers.title: MTmixAtt: Integrating Mixture-of-Experts with Multi-Mix Attention for Large-Scale Recommendation
papers.contribution: MoE + multi-mix attention with AutoToken; scales to 1B params

papers.title: INFNet: Aggregate and Broadcast: Scalable and Efficient Feature Interaction for Recommender Systems
papers.contribution: Linear-complexity task-aware feature interaction via aggregate-and-broadcast hub tokens

papers.title: Zenith: Scaling Up Ranking Models for Billion-Scale Livestreaming Recommendation
papers.contribution: Scales ranking models for livestream scenarios; demonstrates scaling benefits for feature interactions

papers.title: TokenMixer-Large: Scaling Up Large Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
papers.contribution: Addresses hardware under-utilization in scaling; optimized TokenMixer architecture for industrial deployment

papers.title: MSN: A Memory-based Sparse Activation Scaling Framework for Large-scale Industrial Recommendation
papers.contribution: Product-Key Memory with sub-linear retrieval; sparse activation via Top-k memory slots; deployed in Douyin Search Ranking

papers.title: HeteroMixer: Query-Mixed Interest Extraction and Heterogeneous Interaction
papers.contribution: Query-mixed interest extraction with heterogeneous interaction for sparse multi-field inputs and ultra-long sequences

papers.title: ML-DCN: Masked Low-Rank Deep Crossing Network Towards Scalable Ads CTR at Pinterest
papers.contribution: Instance-conditioned mask + low-rank crossing layer for scalable ads CTR; neutral serving cost

papers.title: CADET: Context-Conditioned Ads CTR Prediction With a Decoder-Only Transformer

papers.title: Expand More, Shrink Less: Shaping Effective-Rank Dynamics for Dense Scaling in Recommendation
papers.contribution: Identifies embedding collapse in RankMixer-style dense scaling; RankElastor with spectrum-robust scaling

papers.title: SpecFormer: Mitigating Embedding and Attention Collapse via Spectral-Aware Transformer for Recommendation
papers.contribution: Reveals embedding/attention collapse as depth-scaling bottleneck; Spectral Softening unlocks effective depth-scaling

papers.title: OCP: Orthogonal Constrained Projection for Sparse Scaling in Industrial Commodity Recommendation
papers.contribution: Orthogonal constrained projection for sparse embedding scaling; +12.97% UCXR, +8.9% GMV on JD.com

papers.title: GateDiffInt: Gate-Mediated Controllable Diffusion and Multi-Intent LLM Distillation for User Behavior Modeling
papers.contribution: Controllable forward diffusion + LLM distillation for behavior denoising; deployed at hundreds of millions DAU

papers.title: HubMixer: Progressive Latent Hub Mixing for Parameter-Efficient Feature Interaction in Recommendation
papers.contribution: Learnable latent hubs organize heterogeneous tokens via induction–interaction–readout; parameter-efficient feature interaction; +5.48% resume submission conversion in Kuaishou recruitment A/B

papers.title: PRIME: Mitigating Subgroup Optimization Competition in Shared CTR Top Networks with Plug-in Residual Input-Conditioned Mixture of Expert
papers.contribution: Dense-anchored low-rank residual MoE with zero-residual init; input-conditioned routing for example-specific logit corrections; mitigates subgroup optimization competition in shared CTR top networks across 13 architectures

papers.title: ReST: From Language to Behavior: Scaling Sequence Transformers for Industrial Recommendation Ranking with Rec-Native Designs
papers.contribution: Rec-native Transformer scaling: dual-gated attention + RoPE temporal encoding for noisy behavior sequences; heavy encoder + lightweight cross decoder with shared-prefix serving for compute-once decode-many ranking; AUC +1.31%, revenue +11.93% in ads A/B test

papers.title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
papers.contribution: Compress-then-reason: Sketch Attention compresses 100K history into fixed-size target-agnostic representation + Stacked Target-to-History Cross Attention for multi-scale interests; low-rank caching + multi-request batching + fused FlashSA kernel; deployed at full traffic on Douyin

papers.title: SOLAR: SVD-Optimized Lifelong Attention for Recommendation
papers.contribution: SVD-Attention approximates token-level softmax in a compact principal-interest space and combines lifelong-history interaction with candidate-set context; handles 12K behaviors and 3K candidates, with AUC 0.8531 versus 0.8533 for full softmax and p95 latency 19 versus 76 ms in the industrial benchmark

papers.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
papers.contribution: Unified tokenizer + causal attention + KV caching; co-optimizes sequence and feature interaction

papers.title: HyFormer: Revisiting the Roles of Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in CTR Prediction

papers.title: EST: Towards Efficient Scaling Laws in Click-Through Rate Prediction via Unified Modeling
papers.contribution: Efficient unified modeling for scalable CTR; addresses early aggregation limitations

papers.title: MixFormer: Co-Scaling Up Dense and Sequence in Industrial Recommenders
papers.contribution: User-item decoupled architecture; co-scales dense features and user sequences

papers.title: TokenFormer: Unify the Multi-Field and Sequential Recommendation Worlds
papers.contribution: Bottom-Full-Top-Sliding attention; solves Sequential Collapse Propagation

papers.title: UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems
papers.contribution: Unifies attention/TokenMixer/FM into single scaling framework; proposes UniMixing-Lite

papers.title: TMallGS: Scaling Unified Feature and Sequence Modeling for Generative E-commerce Search
papers.contribution: Hierarchical Distribution-Calibrated Tokenization + Field-Adaptive Gated Transformer for Tmall search

papers.title: MaskRec: Topology-Masked Unified Backbone for Joint Feature Interaction and Multi-Domain Sequence Modeling
papers.contribution: Unified token interaction space with a structured TopoMask attention mask + learnable global/domain memory tokens; jointly models heterogeneous feature interaction and multi-domain behavior sequences within a single backbone for CVR prediction

papers.title: CRAFT: From Feature Interaction to Feature Transport — A Unified Block for Scalable Recommendation Models
papers.contribution: Contextual Residual Adaptive Feature Transport block; treats deep unified recommendation as context-conditioned representation evolution; non-sequential context actively controls intent/sequence transport via residual displacement + memory preservation; benefits from both depth (6 blocks) and width expansion; TAAC2026 ads competition best AUC

papers.title: UniCon: A Unified Context-Centric Modeling Paradigm for CTR Prediction
papers.contribution: Unified context-centric architecture treating the request context as the basic modeling unit; organizes history and prediction targets as homogeneous context units; intra-context attention captures local item coupling (Locality) while inter-context attention models decision-state evolution (Dynamics); bridges the history–target structural gap for more effective scaling of unified CTR models

papers.title: HELIX: Purified and Unified - Rethinking Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling for Large-Scale Recommendation
papers.contribution: Interleaves behavior retrieval and heterogeneous feature interaction with one-way sequence-to-candidate information flow; reusable user-side K/V states enable asymmetric scaling and amortized training/serving; scales from 46M to 1.05B parameters, with HELIX-L lifting video GMV/user 5.99% in TikTok e-commerce A/B

papers.title: LiRank: Industrial Large Scale Ranking Models at LinkedIn
papers.contribution: Residual DCN + Transformer + Dense Gating; quantization and compression for serving

papers.contribution: Foundation model + surface-specific experts; HyperCast infrastructure; first Foundation-Expert deployment at scale

papers.title: OnePiece: Bringing Context Engineering and Reasoning to Industrial Cascade Ranking System

papers.title: LUM: Unlocking Scaling Law in Industrial Recommendation Systems with a Three-step Paradigm based Large User Model
papers.contribution: Three-step paradigm (pre-training → fine-tuning → distillation) based Large User Model; scales to 7B parameters

papers.title: MTFM: A Scalable and Alignment-Free Foundation Model for Industrial Recommendation in Meituan

papers.title: UniPinRec: Unifying Generative Retrieval and Ranking at Pinterest Scale

papers.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
papers.contribution: Eliminates encoder-predictor separation in multi-task ranking; task-private channels with dynamic scoring

papers.title: OneModel: A Unified Foundation for Platform-Scale Multi-Scenario Ranking
papers.contribution: Unified multi-stream ranking with Scenario-aware Information Modulation; deployed at Xiaohongshu

papers.title: AMBER: An Event is Worth One Token — Event Tokenization for Industrial-scale LLM Recommendation

papers.title: OneTrans-V2: Unifying Retrieval, Pre-rank, and Fine-rank with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender

papers.title: UG-Sep: Compute Only Once: UG-Separation for Efficient Large Recommendation Models
papers.contribution: User-general feature separation to reduce redundant computation; enables affordable scaling

papers.title: TransX: Scaling Transformer-based Recommendation via Behavioral and Serving Stream Crossings
papers.contribution: Encoder-decoder decoupling behavior/serving streams; 80% compute reduction with +6.0% CTR

papers.title: SlimPer: Make Personalization Model Slim and Smart

papers.title: Selective Test-Time Compute Scaling for CTR Prediction via Uncertainty-Triggered Feature Path Exploration
papers.contribution: Training-free per-instance test-time compute scaling; routes uncertain instances through stochastic paths

papers.title: Exploring Test-time Scaling via Prediction Merging on Large-Scale Recommendation

papers.title: DS-Frame: Recommender System as Slow and Fast Thinkers
